outcomes.statement: Calculate physical-clock drift, skew, and uncertainty and diagnose conclusions that exceed the available clock contract.
Derive happened-before, Lamport-clock, and vector-clock relationships without treating display order as causality.
Separate safety, liveness, and failure-detector assumptions and select consensus only for properties that require agreement.
Implement and diagnose Raft elections, persistent hard state, log matching, commitment, and state-machine application.
Implement client deduplication and linearizable reads with explicit ambiguous-outcome and quorum barriers.
Protect snapshots, membership changes, leases, and external resources with atomic state, overlapping quorums, and fencing.
Diagnose eight coordination failures from immutable same-input evidence and scoped safety oracles.
Defend a coordination architecture covering alternatives, operating limits, security, cost, migration, ownership, dissent, and reversal evidence.

challenge_questions.prompt: Which claim in your artifact most directly supports this outcome, and what evidence could falsify it: Calculate physical-clock drift, skew, and uncertainty and diagnose conclusions that exceed the available clock contract.

What unstated assumption could invalidate your treatment of this outcome, and how would you test it: Derive happened-before, Lamport-clock, and vector-clock relationships without treating display order as causality.

Defend the causal chain behind your evidence for this outcome, including the first likely failure: Separate safety, liveness, and failure-detector assumptions and select consensus only for properties that require agreement.

Which reasonable alternative would challenge your treatment of this outcome, and under what evidence would it win: Implement and diagnose Raft elections, persistent hard state, log matching, commitment, and state-machine application.

What operational, security, cost, or ownership consequence is least supported in your treatment of this outcome: Implement client deduplication and linearizable reads with explicit ambiguous-outcome and quorum barriers.

Where does your evidence stop transferring to production for this outcome, and how is that boundary disclosed: Protect snapshots, membership changes, leases, and external resources with atomic state, overlapping quorums, and fencing.

What dissent should a skeptical reviewer raise about your treatment of this outcome, and what follow-up evidence would resolve it: Diagnose eight coordination failures from immutable same-input evidence and scoped safety oracles.

What changed belief or reversal condition follows from your work on this outcome, and where is it recorded: Defend a coordination architecture covering alternatives, operating limits, security, cost, migration, ownership, dissent, and reversal evidence.
